title: Desktop Experience
objective: Add a cross-platform desktop client only after CLI/TUI/Guardian domain contracts are stable.

stories.title: Desktop API boundary
stories.outcome: Expose a narrow local IPC/API that reuses engine plans and explanations.
verification: Unauthorized local client and schema compatibility tests.

stories.title: Cross-platform desktop shell
stories.outcome: Implement tray/menu-bar/dashboard experience using shared core, with Tauri or an equivalent evidence-backed choice.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop is optional and core remains headless-capable.
UI shows the same inventory/policy semantics as CLI/TUI.
